description: Cold Jellyfish Salad is a quintessential Chinese appetizer, renowned for its unique crunchy and chewy texture. This refreshing dish combines tender strips of jellyfish with crisp vegetables, all tossed in a savory, tangy, and slightly spicy dressing. It's a perfect starter that tantalizes the palate and awakens the appetite with its vibrant flavors.

ingredients.notes: rinsed and drained, cut into thin strips

instructions.title: Prepare the Jellyfish
instructions.text: If using dried jellyfish, rehydrate according to package instructions, usually by soaking in cold water for several hours or overnight, changing water multiple times. For pre-packaged jellyfish, rinse thoroughly under cold running water to remove excess salt and chemicals. Briefly blanch the rinsed jellyfish in boiling water for 10-15 seconds, then immediately transfer to an ice bath to stop cooking and maintain its crisp texture. Drain well and gently squeeze out any excess water. Cut into thin, bite-sized strips if not already done.

instructions.title: Prepare the Vegetables
instructions.text: Wash and peel the cucumber and carrot. Using a sharp knife or mandoline, julienne both the cucumber and carrot into thin, uniform strips. Place them in a large mixing bowl along with the prepared jellyfish.

instructions.title: Make the Dressing
instructions.text: In a small bowl, combine the minced garlic, grated ginger, light soy sauce, Chinese black vinegar, sesame oil, and sugar. Whisk the ingredients together until the sugar is fully dissolved and the dressing is well combined. Add chili oil to your desired level of spice and mix again.

instructions.title: Combine and Toss
instructions.text: Pour the prepared dressing over the jellyfish, cucumber, and carrot in the large mixing bowl. Using tongs or clean hands, gently toss all the ingredients together until everything is evenly coated with the dressing. Ensure the delicate jellyfish strips are not overly compressed during mixing.

instructions.title: Chill for Flavor Infusion
instructions.text: Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate the Cold Jellyfish Salad for at least 30 minutes. Chilling allows the flavors to meld beautifully and enhances the refreshing quality of the salad. For best results, chill for an hour or more.

instructions.title: Garnish and Serve
instructions.text: Before serving, give the salad another gentle toss. Transfer the Cold Jellyfish Salad to a serving platter or individual bowls. Garnish generously with fresh chopped cilantro and a sprinkle of toasted sesame seeds for added aroma and visual appeal. Serve immediately as a refreshing appetizer.

tips: To achieve the perfect crunchy-chewy texture for jellyfish, always blanch it very briefly (10-15 seconds) in boiling water, then immediately plunge into an ice bath.

For an extra layer of flavor, consider adding a pinch of white pepper or a dash of Shaoxing wine to the dressing. You can also vary the vegetables with shredded red bell pepper or a few thin slices of red onion.

This salad is best served well-chilled. If preparing in advance, keep the dressing separate and combine with the jellyfish and vegetables about 1-2 hours before serving for optimal texture and freshness.
